The girl's name is Four.
AEUG and Titans.
Though they know their true allegiances

secretly meets Four in Hong Kong

rows.en: The Titans' Cyber Newtype
Four Murasame,
to smoke out the AEUG,
boards the Psycho Gundam
and burns the streets of Hong Kong City.
Overwhelming power keeps all foes away
from the Psycho, but
the thoughts emanating from the Gundam Mk-II
force it to retreat.
Amid the Titans' ongoing cowardly schemes,
Four happens to meet a boy: Kamille.
make them foes, the two are drawn together.
rows.note: Same as S02160 (the JP differs only in full-width 2). Follows S02159 in zg08.

rows.en: Slipping off the ship to meet Kamille in secret,
Four heads for the meeting place.
rows.note: The JP row is 'heading Four'. Row 1 keeps the ship and the secret meeting; row 2 has Four setting off.

rows.en: Kilimanjaro
At the Titans' base on Kilimanjaro,
Kamille sneaks in and is reunited with Four.
Four is cheerful, a different person now.
Kamille, though bewildered,
searches the base for her headache medicine,
rows.note: Ends with a comma, no 'but': the shared next row S02187 supplies the contrast with 'only to be'.

rows.en: only to be spotted by Jerid.
rows.note: Shared by zg09 (Kamille, singular) and zg10 (the two, plural). 'only to be' works for either number and covers the JP 'ga ... shimau'.

rows.en: The two flee outside the base, but
Four's headache brings on a strange change.
rows.note: The JP word means an abnormal change. Left as vague as the JP.

rows.en: Moved to the Kilimanjaro base,
Four is reunited with Kamille,
rows.note: 'is reunited with Kamille' moved up from S02192 for natural English order. S02192 keeps the 'who sneaked in' part.

But as her medication wears off, Four
begins to suffer from headaches.
The two search the base for headache medicine,
rows.note: Ends with a comma, no 'but': followed by the shared row S02187 'only to be spotted by Jerid.'

rows.en: Between the AEUG, the Titans and Axis,
the three-way battle
over the colony laser
comes to a final showdown.
Scirocco and Haman target the laser.
Quattro and Kamille defend it.
Having lost so many comrades,
can they claim victory?
The battle's outcome is still undecided.
Having done away with Jamitov and Bask
but lost Sarah and Reccoa,
a cornered Scirocco,
with the ultimate mobile suit he built himself,
rows.note: 47 chars against a 15-char JP line; check the fit.

rows.en: "The-O", stakes all on one last battle.
has come to a final showdown.
rows.note: Past-tense zg16 version of S02216. Follows the shared rows S02213-S02215.

decisions: Present-tense narration, matching the JP and the previous slice.

Sentences are cut at the JP row boundaries. Where a JP row is only a sentence ending (no-datta / to iu mono de aru / suru no datta), the end of the English sentence goes there rather than leaving the row empty.
Rows shared by several mission files (S02159, S02187, S02200, S02213-S02215) are worded to read correctly in each file that uses them.
Z written as 'the Zeta' (short for Zeta Gundam), Gundam Mk-II spelled as in the glossary, and JP corner brackets written as ASCII double quotes.
uncertain: S02201: JP says Axis holds the colony laser; translated as written.
S02189: the JP word means 'abnormal change'; rendered vaguely as 'a strange change'.
S02160/S02177, S02178, S02225: 43-48 chars, over the 2.4x width guide; needs a real fit check.
S02164/S02165, S02191/S02192, S02206/S02207: content moved across the row cut because English word order could not keep the JP split.
